name: 180. Anthropic computer tool mux, batched computer actions, server-tool cache_control (anthropic-computer-mux)
description:
Three conversion fixes on the Responses -> Anthropic path (core/providers/anthropic/responses.go), plus the reverse tool mapping.

1. Server-tool cache_control. convertBifrostToolToAnthropic built every server tool (web_search, web_fetch, code_execution, dated computer, memory, tool_search, bash, text_editor, advisor) without cache_control; only plain function tools and the computer toolset kept it. A prompt-cache breakpoint on a server tool silently vanished. Fix: applyResponsesToolAnthropicFlags copies cache_control for every branch. 180.1 pins it on web_search and the dated computer tool.

2. OpenAI computer tool. The newer {type:"computer"} tool (no display or environment fields) had no case in convertBifrostToolToAnthropic, fell through to the function-tool path and was dropped for having no name - the model ran without the tool and nothing reported it. Fix: it becomes the bare computer_toolset_20260801 wherever the target takes a toolset (180.2 Anthropic, 180.3 Vertex) and is dropped where it does not, since dated tools require display_*_px >= 1 (180.4, a guard: it was already dropped, now by design and reported by ValidateResponsesToolsForProvider). Reverse: an Anthropic toolset used to become computer_use_preview with a 0x0 display; it now maps to {type:"computer"} (180.5, /anthropic drop-in -> OpenAI).

3. Batched computer actions. computer_call.actions (folder 179 added the field) was ignored by the Anthropic converter. Request side: a call carrying only actions became a tool_use with no input. It now becomes one tool_use per action - earlier actions get <call_id>_<i>, the last keeps the call id so the single screenshot output pairs with it - and each earlier action gets an "ok" filler tool_result (180.6). Response side: a Claude computer tool_use now reaches the client with the action in both action (computer_use_preview clients) and actions:[action] (computer tool clients), non-streaming (180.6) and streaming (180.7). This differs from folder 179, which leaves action unsynthesized for OpenAI's own replies: there the upstream chose the batched shape, here Bifrost is producing the OpenAI shape from Anthropic's single action, so it fills both readers' fields.
